question: Can changing the order of the same numbers change the answer?
result: Yes. The correct sum was 512. The same GPU calculation returned 512 for one order and 256 for another, in all four trials of each.
limits: This used one browser session and matching reported adapter details. It did not assess other devices, performance, gravity, layout or production readiness.
environment: Headless Chrome 157; luma 10.0.0-alpha.15; Apple WebGPU reported metal-3 and fallback false. The adapter model and backend were not reported.
evidence: Twelve trial records and a summary are retained locally in experiments/cosmos-gpu-lab/captures/new-order-followup-20261118T100325Z-24320/.
reproduction: Start with a clean isolated checkout of the recorded source revision and install its lockfile dependencies.
Apply the preserved test patch and run order-followup.test.ts with a unique LAB_ARTIFACT_RUN directory.
Record the actual browser and adapter, and inspect all 12 trial records and the summary. The linked recipe contains the exact commands.
